title: S44 — Confidence scoring: reject low-confidence reads instead of guessing
desc: Currently we always return a read even if confidence is low. Implement confidence threshold: if avg_confidence < 0.5, return 'UNCERTAIN' instead of guessing. Measure: (1) how many reads become UNCERTAIN? (2) of the remaining reads, what's the accuracy? Owner: barry. Priority: 3.

history.note: Dropped: confidence gate measured DEAD in S28/S29. No score separation exists to threshold on.
